status: frozen before any contrastive calibration output
purpose: Select a pair-quality-sensitive downstream representation learner without inspecting max-probability versus top-two-margin outcomes.

feature_protocol.cost_independence: all 100 held-out genes were excluded from OT cost construction
feature_protocol.standardization: source training spots and the target candidate pool are standardized separately within each spatial fold
feature_protocol.test_truth_use: test truth is used only for evaluation

calibration_design.corruption: non-clean training pairs receive a uniformly sampled incorrect target; clean membership is nested across purity levels

optimizer.loss: paired ranking loss with eight random incorrect targets per positive pair

leave_one_patient_out_selection.selection_rule: Among eligible learners, select the largest median patient-level MRR difference between purity 1 and purity 0 on the other seven patients; break ties by candidate_learners order.
leave_one_patient_out_selection.failure_rule: If no learner is eligible for any held-out patient, stop before score comparison.

claim_boundary: Calibration only establishes sensitivity to training-pair correctness. It cannot show that top-two margin improves downstream learning.
